contexts.text: He acquired for himself a sphere of being more excellent than others.

Evil Spirits are only allowed to operate into those things which a man has actually acquired for himself... wherefore before a man acquires for himself such spheres, the Evil Spirits serve, but as soon as he acquires them, they infuse themselves into him.

The life which a man has acquired for himself in the world follows him... no one can put off the life that he has acquired for himself from infancy... as for example, he who has acquired for himself a life of deceit...
That there was provision in Egypt = the mind of procuring for itself truths through scientifics.
There are two ways of procuring the truths that are of faith...

1.2. Your silver came to me = that it will seem like truth procured by them. Their silver coming to him denotes that they bought it, thus that they procured it for themselves; for to buy is to procure... and since the truth that is of faith is never procured by any man, but is insinuated and given by the Lord, and yet it seems as if it were [procured] by man, it is said that it will seem like truth procured by them.
Nevertheless it appears that the truths which are of faith are procured by man.
They who only know the truths of faith, commit them to memory like any other things of any science; these a man can procure for himself without such influx.
These are what a man cannot procure for himself even in the smallest degree. Compare with AC 6822:end.

The first thing with these is that they procure for themselves doctrine from the literal sense of the Word... but after doctrine has been procured they see the Word from it. But they who do not procure for themselves doctrine...
They who through knowledges and sciences have procured for themselves intelligence and wisdom...
They who believe that they can from their own intelligence procure for themselves knowledges about God...
That man can contribute something towards the acquiring for himself of faith...

That a man is able to acquire faith for himself... faith in its essence is truth, and truths from the Word can be acquired by every one, and in proportion as any one acquires them for himself, and loves them, he initiates faith into himself... unless a man were able to acquire faith for himself, all things that are commanded in the Word concerning faith would be vain...
That a man is able to acquire charity for himself.
That a man is also able to acquire for himself the life of faith and of charity.
Man is prosperous and blessed if he acquires for himself wisdom.
